Limitations of measuring nitrogen balance include the inherent 
error of 24-hour urine collection, failure to account for renal
impairment, and inability to measure nitrogen losses from 
some wounds, burns, diarrhea, and vomiting. Nitrogen intake 
may also pose diﬃ  culties. Oral protein intake may be diﬃ  cult
to measure except when the patient is exclusively on enteral or 
parenteral nutrition support.
